Dragonfield

A downloadable game for Windows

Dragonfield

Wishlist the upcoming release of Dragonfield on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/1354450/Dragonfield/

Dragonfield has a Discord server now - You are welcome to join and suggest your ideas and give feedback

🎉🎉

As a reminder if you have not seen it already:

Dragonfield will get a new title with the next update, Alpha 11!

🎉🎉

ALPHA 10 - The Crossbow Overhaul Update - HAS BEEN RELEASED! Check out the patch notes here!

Thank you everyone for your amazing feedback so far, there are many more free updates coming!

--Game description--

Fight in epic medieval fantasy sandbox battles! Inspired by the "good old days" of gaming where you could just sit down and play a few rounds against bots!

Use swords, shields, bows, magic and even ballistas and more. Upcoming free updates will bring catapults and - of course - flyable dragons.

Watch armies of bots battle it out with ragdoll physics!

I've been working on Dragonfield alone for over 3 years now, doing everything myself - and I am looking forward to hear what you think!

You can check the controls in the pause menu!

Upcoming updates include: Dragons to fly and fight, large sieges with ladders, catapults and desctructible environments, a huge variety of weapons to choose from, army customization, full mod support! And a LOT more!

You are welcome to join the Dragonfield Discord server here!

Dont forget to wishlist it on Steam - Thank you for your support and awesome feedback so far!
